name: Kaynes Technology

snapshot.about: Kaynes Technology provides electronics manufacturing services, semiconductor packaging, PCB manufacturing, and space technology solutions.

narrative: Management delivered 33% revenue growth in FY26 to ₹3,626 crore. However, results diverged from targets: revenue missed the promised ₹4,000 crore minimum, operating cash flow was −₹600 crore despite guidance to be positive, and working capital reached 122 days versus 70–85 days.

promises.statement: Management expects total FY26 revenue to cross at least INR 4,000 crores (INR 40,000 million).

said.quote: including the last quarter for FY '26, we'll cross about INR4,000 crores minimum and mainly driven by EMS revenues

actual_source.source: screener.in, compiled from the company's filed results

promises.statement: Company expects consolidated operating cash flow to be positive for full year FY26.

cash.read: Profits do not convert to cash. Operating cash flow was −₹615 crore over FY22–FY26 against ₹977 crore reported profit, with negative free cash flow every year and expanding debtor days.

bull.point: Revenue grew 40% year-on-year in Q1 FY27 to ₹946 crore, supported by strong 48% growth in the core EMS business.

evidence.quote: Our total revenue stood at INR946 crores, reflecting an year-on-year growth of 40%, which is largely driven by EMS business

bull.point: The company maintains a strong order book of ₹9,000 crore, demonstrating broad multi-year demand for its manufacturing services.

evidence.quote: We have a robust order book of around INR9,000 crores

bull.point: Kaynes secured ₹170 crore in government subsidies for OSAT through July 2026 while advancing its semiconductor and PCB manufacturing facilities.

evidence.quote: Both Kaynes Semicon Unit 2 and Kaynes Circuit Chennai remain on the track to be operational by quarter 3 FY27, and we will continue to update you transparently on our progress every quarter
We also received, happy to say that we also received the government subsidy to the tune of INR170 crores in OSAT business till July 26
